//! The S1 principal store, durably backed by a real connection pool — state survives a restart.
//! Plus: a legitimate in-memory CACHE/derived view is NOT a system-of-record and is admitted.

/// The S1 principal store — durable-backed (a real pool), so it persists across a restart.
pub struct PrincipalStore {
    pool: PgPool,
}

/// A legitimate in-memory cache (rebuildable lookup) — NOT a durable system-of-record, admitted.
pub struct PrincipalCache {
    inner: std::sync::Mutex<std::collections::BTreeMap<String, Row>>,
}

/// A deliberate in-memory test/dev double (the `Mem*` prefix) — admitted by the precise scope.
pub struct MemPrincipalStore {
    inner: std::sync::Mutex<std::collections::BTreeMap<String, Row>>,
}
